CVE-2025-24813.description: In Apache Tomcat, when the DefaultServlet is configured with readonly=false (allowing PUT writes), an attacker can exploit path equivalence and partial PUT mechanisms to upload malicious serialized files, potentially leading to remote code execution (RCE) if file-based session persistence is enabled or arbitrary content injection.

vulnerability.title: Potential RCE and/or information disclosure and/or malicious content added to uploaded files via write enabled Default Servlet

information_disclosure_or_content_inject.name: default_servlet_writes_enabled
information_disclosure_or_content_inject.description: Writes must be enabled for the Default Servlet.

information_disclosure_or_content_inject.name: partial_put_enabled
information_disclosure_or_content_inject.description: Partial PUT support must be enabled.

information_disclosure_or_content_inject.name: security_sensitive_upload_path_relationship
information_disclosure_or_content_inject.description: A target URL for security-sensitive uploads must be a sub-directory of a target URL for public uploads.

information_disclosure_or_content_inject.name: attacker_knows_sensitive_filename
information_disclosure_or_content_inject.description: The attacker must know the names of security-sensitive files being uploaded.

information_disclosure_or_content_inject.name: sensitive_files_use_partial_put
information_disclosure_or_content_inject.description: The security-sensitive files must also be uploaded using partial PUT.

remote_code_execution.name: default_servlet_writes_enabled
remote_code_execution.description: Writes must be enabled for the Default Servlet.

remote_code_execution.name: partial_put_enabled
remote_code_execution.description: Partial PUT support must be enabled.

remote_code_execution.name: file_based_session_persistence
remote_code_execution.description: The application must use Tomcat file-based session persistence with the default storage location.

remote_code_execution.name: deserialization_library
remote_code_execution.description: The application must include a library that may be leveraged in a deserialization attack.

remediation.primary: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to a fixed version.

validation.version_check: Verify the running Tomcat version is fixed.
validation.behavioral_check: Verify that the vulnerable configuration or behavior is no longer present.

CVE-2024-50379.description: Time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in Apache Tomcat DefaultServlet write operations on case-insensitive file systems (such as Windows) allows remote attackers to upload arbitrary files and achieve Remote Code Execution.

vulnerability.title: Apache Tomcat DefaultServlet TOCTOU Race Condition Remote Code Execution

remote_code_execution.name: default_servlet_writes_enabled
remote_code_execution.description: DefaultServlet must be explicitly configured with readonly=false to permit HTTP PUT requests.

remote_code_execution.name: file_write_path_accessible
remote_code_execution.description: Tomcat web application root or write target directory must accept write operations.

remediation.primary: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to 9.0.99, 10.1.34, 11.0.2 or later, or set readonly=true in conf/web.xml.
remediation.configuration_mitigation: Set readonly to true for DefaultServlet in /opt/tomcat/conf/web.xml

validation.behavioral_check: Send HTTP PUT to ensure 405 Method Not Allowed is returned

CVE-2024-56337.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2024-50379 in Apache Tomcat allows remote code execution when DefaultServlet write is enabled on case-insensitive filesystems.

vulnerability.title: Apache Tomcat DefaultServlet TOCTOU Race Condition Bypass RCE

remote_code_execution.name: default_servlet_writes_enabled
remote_code_execution.description: DefaultServlet must be explicitly configured with readonly=false.

remediation.primary: Upgrade to Apache Tomcat 9.0.99 or later, or disable DefaultServlet write support.

CVE-2020-1938.description: When using the Apache JServ Protocol (AJP), Tomcat treats connections with higher trust than HTTP. If the AJP connector is exposed to untrusted clients without secret authentication, an attacker can read arbitrary files from webapps or achieve RCE via file inclusion.

arbitrary_file_read_and_rce.name: ajp_connector_active
arbitrary_file_read_and_rce.description: An AJP/1.3 Connector must be configured and active in server.xml.

remediation.primary: Upgrade to Tomcat 9.0.31 or comment out the AJP Connector in server.xml if not in use.
remediation.configuration_mitigation: Disable AJP connector or configure secretRequired="true" with a strong secret.

CVE-2017-12615.description: When running on Windows with HTTP PUT enabled (via readonly=false in DefaultServlet), an attacker can upload arbitrary JSP files using trailing slashes or NTFS stream syntax, resulting in remote code execution.

vulnerability.title: Apache Tomcat Remote Code Execution via HTTP PUT

remote_code_execution.name: default_servlet_writes_enabled
remote_code_execution.description: DefaultServlet must be configured with readonly=false.

remediation.primary: Upgrade to Tomcat 7.0.82 or ensure readonly=true in DefaultServlet.

vulnerability.title: Flask: Information disclosure via improper caching of session data

CVE-2026-27205.description: Flask versions 3.1.2 and below may fail to set the Vary: Cookie header when accessing session objects using certain patterns (such as the Python 'in' operator), potentially leading to caching of sensitive session data.

remediation.guidance: Upgrade Flask to version 3.1.3 or higher.

vulnerability.title: Flask: Possible disclosure of permanent session cookie due to missing Vary: Cookie header

CVE-2023-30861.description: Flask versions prior to 2.2.5 and 2.3.2 lack a Vary: Cookie header in responses when permanent sessions are used, which could lead to caching proxies serving one user's session cookie to another.

remediation.guidance: Upgrade Flask to version 2.3.2, 2.2.5, or higher.
